dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible light-colored, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast perimeters. These structures feature a transition from a dark exterior background to thin, high-intensity borders surrounding dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. Bright pixels are primarily organized into thin, reticulated filaments rather than dense, asymmetrical blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent ring-like structures in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.
